comment_mentions_target_identity_check.name: comment_mentions_target_identity_check
comment_mentions_target_identity_check.value:
(
        (
          "target_type" = 'human'
          AND "target_human_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "target_bot_id" IS NULL
        )
        OR
        (
          "target_type" = 'bot'
          AND "target_bot_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "target_human_id" IS NULL
        )
      )
